# ForbTech

> Affordable website development, app development, Google Business Profile setup and IT services for businesses in Gujarat, India.

## Services
- [Website Development](https://forb-tech-solutions.vercel.app/services/website-development): Fast, mobile-friendly websites for local businesses.
- [Google Business Profile](https://forb-tech-solutions.vercel.app/services/google-business-profile): Setup and optimisation for Google Maps and local search.
- [App Development](https://forb-tech-solutions.vercel.app/services/app-development): Android, iOS and web apps.
- [IT Support](https://forb-tech-solutions.vercel.app/services/it-support): Hosting, domains, business email and maintenance.
- [E-Commerce & Digital Catalogs](https://forb-tech-solutions.vercel.app/services/ecommerce): WhatsApp ordering and digital stores with 0% commissions.
- [UI / UX Design](https://forb-tech-solutions.vercel.app/services/ui-ux-design): Clean, conversion-focused mobile and web interface design.
